Only the one intended file changed, uncommitted as required. Here's my report:

**STATUS: DONE**

## What I implemented

In `crates/bridge-acp/src/acp_backend.rs` (Task 5, the keystone):

1. **`AcpBackend::run_watchdog`** (new associated fn, `'static`, no `&self`, placed next to `escalate_terminate`): loops, computing `deadline = min(turn_start + hard_wall_clock, la_instant + idle_timeout)` (idle deadline only considered once `la != 0`), `select!`s `sleep_until(Instant::from_std(deadline))` vs `&mut done_rx`. On wake it reloads `la` and re-checks both bounds against real elapsed time; if either is truly exceeded it `notify_one()`s and exits, else re-derives and loops (handles the handler advancing `la` mid-check — PFIX-L saturating math, `la_instant = turn_start + Duration::from_millis(la.saturating_sub(1))`).
2. **`prompt_inner` setup**: consolidated the `config.watchdog` lookup into `watchdog_cfg`, derived `watch` from it (unchanged behavior), then built `watchdog_fired: Option<Arc<Notify>>` and `watchdog_done_tx: Option<oneshot::Sender<()>>`, spawning `run_watchdog` only when all three of `watch`/`fired`/`watchdog_cfg` are `Some`.
3. **Driver `select!`**: added a 4th arm awaiting `watchdog_fired.notified()` when `Some`, or `std::future::pending()` when `None` (PFIX-G — no task, arm never fires, byte-identical when disabled). The arm's body runs the same CancelNotification + inner `select!{ prompt_fut | kill | sleep(grace)→escalate_terminate }` as the `done_sender.closed()` arm, but **unconditionally** discards the inner result and sets `timed_out_local = true; Err(())` (PFIX-F keystone — an honored cancel-after-timeout is still `AgentTimedOut`, never propagated as `Ok`).
4. **Teardown**: `drop(watchdog_done_tx)` added right after `map.remove`, on the single straight-line path every turn exit takes (Ok/Err/kill/consumer-drop/timeout) — no leak, no-op when disabled.
5. **Terminal**: `Err(()) if timed_out_local => TurnEvent::Failed(BridgeError::AgentTimedOut)`, ahead of the generic `AgentCrashed` arm; `Ok(resp)` path is untouched (never relabeled).

Test harness extension: added `Recorder.update_interval` (+ `set_update_interval`), defaulting to `None` (no behavior change for any existing test), which makes `emit_updates` sleep before each scripted update when set — needed to exercise real idle-timeout timing.

## Tests (all new, TDD — written first, watched fail, then implemented to green)
- `watchdog_cancels_a_hung_turn_as_timed_out` — hung turn (gated forever, no output), `hard_wall_clock=50ms`, `cancel_grace=50ms` → terminal `Err(AgentTimedOut)`, and confirms the agent actually observed the `session/cancel`.
- `watchdog_does_not_trip_active_or_unmodeled_turn` — (a) 10 `Text` chunks 20ms apart with `idle_timeout=150ms` → completes normally with all 10 chunks; (b) FIX-11: 10 `Thought` (unmodeled) chunks 20ms apart, same config → completes, proving the handler's activity bump runs before the modeled/unmodeled split.
- `no_watchdog_config_is_byte_identical` — `watchdog: None`, hung turn stays pending past 300ms (no self-resolution), then released and completes normally — proving no task was spawned.

## Results
- `cargo test -p bridge-acp --lib`: **108 passed, 0 failed** (105 pre-existing + 3 new).
- `cargo test --workspace --no-run`: green (no missed ripple sites).
- `cargo test --workspace --exclude bridge-container`: **1059 passed, 0 failed, ~12 ignored** (live-gate/e2e tests requiring real agents/docker) — full log inspected for any `FAILED`/`error[`, none found.
- `cargo test -p bridge-container --lib`: **22 passed, 0 failed** (checked separately since the workspace command excludes it; PFIX-I's `ContainerRwConfig` literal still compiles/passes).
- `cargo fmt --all` then `--check`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p bridge-acp --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- No PTY/dyld flake observed.

## Self-review vs the binding constraints
- Watchdog arm always yields `Err(())` + `timed_out_local=true`, no `Ok` leak (PFIX-F) — confirmed in the diff, inner select's arms all resolve to `()`, discarding any prompt result.
- Disabled path is a `Pending` future, no task spawned (PFIX-G) — `watchdog_fired`/`watchdog_done_tx` are `None` iff `config.watchdog` is `None`.
- `tokio::time::Instant::from_std` used for `sleep_until` (PFIX-H).
- `la_instant` round-trip + `saturating_sub` in both the deadline calc and the post-wake check (PFIX-L).
- `drop(watchdog_done_tx)` runs unconditionally on every exit path, right after `map.remove` (no leak).
- `Ok(resp)` is structurally unreachable from the watchdog arm — the outer `select!` picks exactly one arm, so no race.

## Not verified (explicitly out of scope for this task)
- Live-gate against a real ACP agent (codex) — that's Task 6, the controller's job, and needs network/agent creds unavailable in this sandbox.
- Full `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` (only `-p bridge-acp` was in scope here; ran `--workspace --no-run` for compile-only ripple verification, which is what Task 5 calls for).
